pappu.name: Pappu
pappu.role: The over-confident jugaadu. Always has a 'genius' plan, a shortcut or a business idea. Speaks fast, calls everyone 'bhai', ends up the butt of the joke.
pappu.look: tall, saffron gamcha around the neck, spiky hair, thin moustache

golu.name: Golu
golu.role: The gentle, innocent foodie with a round belly. Takes everything literally, gets hungry at the worst moment, believes every rumour. Slow, warm, lovable.
golu.look: short and round, big belly, green topi, rosy cheeks

chhotu.name: Chhotu
chhotu.role: The small, razor-sharp boy who runs Raju's chai tapri. Sees through every plan, always delivers the final punchline, never loses his cool.
chhotu.look: small, blue towel on the shoulder, headband, big eyes, carries a kettle
